description: Locally scored panel of 123 human or humanized approved whole-antibody Fv pairs: every molecule in the Thera-SAbDab February 2025 snapshot meeting those criteria, not a selected subset. Members were not chosen for favorable experimental behavior, and failed structural calculations are excluded from compatible ranges.
limitations: Complete within its definition -- every approved human or humanised paired whole mAb in the snapshot -- but approved antibodies are themselves a survivorship-filtered population, so this is not a representative sample of antibodies in general.

Neither the observed range nor a percentile over it is a safety interval, a clinical acceptance limit, or a ranking of drug quality. A percentile states where a molecule sits among approved drugs; it does not state whether that position is acceptable.
Fv sequences and single predicted structures omit Fc, formulation, concentration, dynamics and measured assays.
Structural reconstruction is a model hypothesis. Rebuilt terminal coordinates are uncertain.
Single-model relaxation/hydrogen placement can vary between runs.
Upstream ANN and Ripley descriptors use unseeded default_rng Monte Carlo (1000 draws), so replicate values fluctuate.
Training-set overlap with these marketed antibodies is unknown; this is not an independent performance-validation set.
Approval labels are from the Thera-SAbDab February 2025 stage column, not a live regulatory-status check.

protocol.preparation: Atlas full-input Fv preparation v2: exact residue identity; terminal reconstruction when needed; CHARMM hydrogens.

antiberty.method: Installed Runner tokenizer and model; one masked pass per residue, special-token logits excluded as in Runner.pseudo_log_likelihood

sources.title: Oxford Thera-SAbDab public sequence download
sources.clinical_status_note: Highest clinical trial stage column dated February 2025; approval labels are source snapshot values.

antiberty_detail_note: Per-residue AntiBERTy scores and region summaries for the reference molecules are not distributed. Nothing in this project reads them: the panel is used only for the per-chain pseudo-log-likelihood comparison and the provenance check that decides comparability. They are regenerated locally by setup/build_reference_data.py if ever needed.
sequence_terms_note: Sequence text removed: derived from Oxford Thera-SAbDab, which publishes no licence grant. Rebuild locally; each chain is verified against the sha256 recorded here.
propermab_descriptors_note: PROPERMAB-derived descriptor values were omitted from this export at the publisher's choice. They are research outputs rather than Regeneron's licensed source code, but omitting them removes any question.
